training_regime: Run B: Full-Train-Split From-Scratch (559 TB + 2660 healthy images; empty targets for healthy images)
script_provenance: train.py is adapted from the official script, multi-task and distributed arguments pruned
trainable_backbone_layers_note: default None; builder enables all 5 backbone layers trainable from scratch without UserWarning

loss_functions.normalization: divided by max(1, num_foreground) per image, averaged over batch

csv_metric_columns.total_loss: sum of component losses from meter 'loss'
csv_metric_columns.loss_bbox_regression: L1 box regression loss from meter 'bbox_regression'

optimization.lr_scaling_rule: Linear scaling with batch size 4 on 1 GPU: 0.01 * (4 / 16) = 0.0025 (Goyal et al., 2017, Section 2.1, page 2 / torchvision docstring). Official v0.29.1 README RetinaNet command uses --lr 0.01 with --weights-backbone ResNet50_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1; Run A deliberately omits that flag.
optimization.lr_milestone_scaling: 16 and 22 of 26 official epochs scaled to 70 epochs (16*70/26=43.08, 22*70/26=59.23)

warmup.formula: min(1000, len(data_loader) - 1); GroupedBatchSampler yields floor(3219 / 4) = 804 batches (3 remainder images skipped per epoch) -> min(1000, 804 - 1) = 803 iters

dataset_policy.train_image_selection: Full canonical train split (3219 images: 559 TB + 2660 healthy images; healthy images have empty box tensors)
dataset_policy.val_test_image_selection: Full canonical sets matching yolo/test.py (690 val, 690 test; healthy background images included with empty box tensors)
dataset_policy.augmentation: RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5) with box coordinate reflection and ToDtype(float, scale=True)

evaluation_protocol.selection_criterion: Maximum Macro-F1 across ActiveTuberculosis and ObsoletePulmonaryTuberculosis
evaluation_protocol.test_split_protocol: Evaluated strictly ONCE using frozen validation-optimal threshold tau*
